content.text: The PR is green, but the inline review found a real high-severity issue: allowing mise to install Rust can put a fixed compiler binary ahead of rustup’s proxy, so the alternate-toolchain benchmark may silently use the wrong compiler. I’m correcting that before merging.

input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"gh pr checkout 350 && sed -n '1,210p' .github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml && rg -n \"MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS|RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN|mise-action|rustup\" .github/workflows mise.toml mise.lock .config 2>/dev/null","workdir":"/Users/jdx/.codex/worktrees/f6e3/mr-boxington","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git fetch origin codex/restore-xlarge-bench-runner && git switch --detach origin/codex/restore-xlarge-bench-runner && sed -n '1,210p' .github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml && rg -n \"MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS|RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN|mise-action|rustup\" .github/workflows mise.toml mise.lock .config 2>/dev/null","workdir":"/Users/jdx/.codex/worktrees/f6e3/mr-boxington","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,120p' mise.toml && sed -n '1,115p' .github/workflows/perf-pr.yml && git show origin/main:.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml | sed -n '38,125p'","workdir":"/Users/jdx/.codex/worktrees/f6e3/mr-boxington","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg -n '^\\[tools\\]|^rust\\s*=|rust =' --glob '*.toml' --glob '*.lock' . | head -80 && git status --short","workdir":"/Users/jdx/.codex/worktrees/f6e3/mr-boxington","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":10000}); text(r.output);

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /Users/jdx/.codex/worktrees/f6e3/mr-boxington/.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml
@@
 env:
   CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
   CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
+  # Keep rustup's proxies on PATH so RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN can select the alternate
+  # compiler used by the toolchain-change benchmark.
+  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust
   RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.97.1
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
